heroHeadline: UC Davis's first Hult Prize chapter, built from the ground up.
heroSubtext: We recruit and train student teams to build for-profit ventures that take on real social and environmental challenges — then send our strongest teams to compete on the national stage.
explainerBody: The Hult Prize is a global student entrepreneurship competition. Teams of students design for-profit ventures that address social and environmental challenges aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, then pitch their ideas and compete through a series of stages toward national and global competition. It turns classroom ideas into real ventures — judged by real entrepreneurs, academics, and industry professionals.
impactStat1Description: student teams have competed through our chapter and its ENG 108 partnership
impactStat2Description: teams advanced from UC Davis to the Hult Prize National Competition
storyBody: Hult Prize @ UC Davis started as one student's idea. Here's how it became a lasting chapter.
ctaHeading: Ready to build something that matters?
ctaBody: Join Hult Prize @ UC Davis and help build ventures that take on the world's biggest challenges — no business background required.
